Great !!!!
Jun 2026 • Solo
Dining alone at **Miya Sushi** turned out to be a wonderful experience. The restaurant has a cozy and relaxing atmosphere, making it a perfect place to enjoy a peaceful meal by yourself.

The food was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of authentic Japanese flavors. Every dish was well-prepared and suited my taste perfectly. You can really tell that quality ingredients and attention to detail are a priority here.

What impressed me the most was the friendly and welcoming staff. They were attentive, polite, and made me feel comfortable throughout my visit without being intrusive. Their warm communication added a personal touch to the entire dining experience.

Overall, Miya Sushi exceeded my expectations. If you're looking for a delicious Japanese restaurant with excellent service and a comfortable atmosphere, I highly recommend giving it a try. I'll definitely be coming back!

Unexpectedly Good Sushi Find
Mar 2026 • Family
Stumbled on Miya Sushi while I was back in Vietnam from Australia and didn’t expect much, but it was actually really good.

Fish tasted fresh, sushi was simple but done right, nothing crazy, just genuinely satisfying. The vibe is pretty chill, small and not too noisy, easy place to just sit down and eat.

Service was quick, no fuss.

Also yeah… no food pics because I got too excited and ate everything straight away 😅

Would definitely go back for a casual sushi fix.
